audience: dispatchers and delivery managers who plan driver routes in OptimoRoute

useCases.title: See the planned routes for a day
useCases.text: The AI reads the routes for a date: per driver or vehicle the duration, distance, loads and ordered stops with times. It also checks whether they were sent to drivers.

useCases.title: Check delivery status, ETA and proof of delivery
useCases.text: The AI reads an order's completion status, service times, notes, signature and photo links, tracking URL, and its driver, stop number and live ETA.

useCases.title: Find failed, rejected or unscheduled orders
useCases.text: The AI searches orders in a date range of up to 35 days by status and shows which need action, with their order data and scheduling info.

useCases.title: Follow driver events on the live routes
useCases.text: The AI reads driver-app events such as start route, start service, success, failed and rejected, and fetches only newer events on the next call.

useCases.title: Create or update delivery orders
useCases.text: The AI creates one order with address geocoding, or creates and updates up to 500 orders in one call, with a mode that only changes the fields you send.

useCases.title: Plan routes for a date and send them to drivers
useCases.text: The AI starts route planning for a date, checks its progress, and sends the finished routes to the drivers' app. Sending cannot be undone.
